meta.title: Form Design — Just say it, and there's your form

hero.sub: Describe what you need like a chat, and Form Design designs the form for you — edit fields as you talk, publish in one click, replies roll in automatically.

items.line: Done — your signup form is ready. Tap any field to edit.
Summary's ready — new replies update it automatically.
Multi-step form is wired up — reorder pages however you like.
Survey's generated — add or edit questions freely.

features.label: Features
features.title: What it does
features.subtitle: It turns designing a form into a conversation.

items.name: Generate by chat
items.desc: Describe what you want to collect in one line; AI assembles a working form on the spot — fields, question types and validation all set up for you.

items.name: AI designs it
items.desc: Not sure which fields to include? Leave it to Form Design — it infers fields by scenario, picks the right question types, and adds required rules and format checks.

items.name: Edit as you chat
items.desc: Need a tweak? Just say it. 'Make phone required', 'add a rating question' — edit by chatting, what you see is what you get.

items.name: Publish & collect
items.desc: Publish in one click to get a link and QR code; anyone can scan and fill, replies auto-aggregate into a table, exportable anytime.

how.label: How it works
how.title: Three steps, from a sentence to collecting data

steps.name: Say what you need
steps.desc: Plainly say what you want to collect: signups, surveys, orders, feedback… one sentence is enough.

steps.name: Refine by chatting
steps.desc: AI generates a first draft; keep chatting to adjust fields, change question types and set required rules until it feels right.

steps.name: Publish & collect
steps.desc: Happy with it? Publish. Share a link or QR code, replies come in live, export whenever you like.

items.title: How do I generate a form?
items.content: Just describe what you want to collect in plain words, e.g. 'make an event signup form with name, phone and session.' Form Design recognizes the scenario, infers the fields, sets up question types and validation, and gives you a working form on the spot.

items.title: Can I edit it after it's generated?
items.content: Yes, anytime. Just keep chatting — 'make phone required,' 'change session to multi-select,' 'add a message question.' Edits are what-you-see-is-what-you-get; keep refining until it feels right.

items.title: How do I collect responses after publishing?
items.content: After one-click publish you get a fill-in link and a QR code; share them and anyone can fill on phone or desktop. Responses come into the backend in real time, auto-aggregate into a table, and can be exported anytime.

items.title: What field and question types are supported?
items.content: All the common ones: single/multi-line text, phone, email, single choice, multiple choice, dropdown, rating, date, file upload and more — plus required rules, format validation and conditional logic.

items.title: Do respondents need to sign up or install anything?
items.content: No. With the link or QR code they fill right in the browser — no signup, no install. To get started yourself, just open form-design.agentaily.com.

footer.tagline: Just say it — and there's your form.
